It's time to test the latest walking machine. It's a quadruped and its inherent mechanics mean that diagonal legs are linked so two feet have to move at once. This leaves only two feet on the ground so we need a way to stabilise the robot when walking on uneven terrain. I took the robot to EMFCamp to test it!

This project is open source: https://github.com/XRobots/Mid-Walker
